items.title: Now is the time to accumulate bitcoin, Galaxy says
items.summary: Galaxy argues improving price trends, resilient ETF demand and rising U.S. debt support bitcoin’s recovery towards its previous high.

items.title: An AI label alone no longer wins lenders, JPMorgan says
items.summary: As default insurance on several AI-linked firms hits record costs, companies must show they can finance investment, service the debt and eventually mint cash, JPMorgan says.

items.title: Solana bug reports now cost 1 SOL as AI floods security teams with spam
items.summary: Researchers must now permanently burn 1 SOL for every submission after a monthlong contest drew 809 reports, with AI believed to have helped generate or write nearly all of them.

items.title: Ethereum fixes Glamsterdam bug that could have sent staking deposits to builders
items.summary: Developers initially rejected the change before reversing course, as testing delays gave them more time to examine a flaw in Ethereum's upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade.

items.title: Zcash co-founder proposes ending grants funding, citing $125 million treasury
items.summary: Sean Bowe’s proposal would send the committee’s 8% share of newly created ZEC to a reserve for future miners. The committee would keep the money it has already received.
